d: Vinicius Junior's relationship with Real Madrid is facing a challenge. From the club's defence of him against racist abuse to the boos at the Santiago Bernabeu, a four-match ban and questions over his form and discipline, the pressure is mounting on the Brazilian forward. With Jose Mourinho now having to manage the situation, can Real Madrid continue to back Vinicius while demanding more from him? Rupha Ramani examines the growing tensions at Real Madrid and what they mean for Vinicius Junior.
